title: Neon Arena
tagline: Dash the grid. Dodge the swarm. Bank the cores before the synthwave clock dies.
pitch: Neon Arena: a fast top-down twin-stick-style arena shooter at night in a synthwave colosseum. A tiny hover-robot dashes around a glowing tiled arena, blasting waves of chasing spiky orbs and patrolling slimes, grabbing energy cores dropped across the floor, and surviving the timer. Neon pink and cyan light, dark night sky, punchy hits, screen shake, scifi HUD.
controls: Mouse: aim the bot's facing (twin-stick style)

plan.title: Neon Arena
plan.tagline: Dash the grid. Dodge the swarm. Bank the cores before the synthwave clock dies.
plan.core_loop: Dash the hover-robot across the glowing arena, weaving through waves of chasing spiky orbs and patrolling slimes, and bank energy cores scattered on the floor before the synthwave clock runs out.
controls: Mouse: aim the bot's facing (twin-stick style)
plan.win_condition: Bank 25 energy cores before the 150-second timer hits zero.
plan.lose_condition: The clock hits zero with the core target unmet, or the bot is destroyed 3 times.
plan.art_direction: Deep indigo night where hot neon pink (#ff2d95) and cyan (#00e5ff) are the only saturated colors; glossy dark arena tiles with an emissive magenta grid, bloom-heavy rim light and soft glow around every prop. Mood: a retro-future colosseum at 2 a.m. — OutRun horizon, Tron light-cycles, high-voltage arcade energy.
concept_shots: Straight-down view: the tiny cyan hover-robot sprints across the glowing magenta grid, a cyan thruster trail streaming behind, while three spiky orbs converge from the arena edge and the screen shakes on a near miss.

The bot weaves between two patrolling slimes around a neon pillar and snags a spinning energy core — a shockwave ring, sparkles and a floating '+1' pop at the pickup as the scifi HUD core counter ticks up.
Final seconds: the timer flashes red at 0:10, the last needed core hovers over the arena centre with orbs swarming in; the bot banks it, slow-mo ripples out, and the win screen bursts in.

assets.sky: Midnight synthwave panorama: deep indigo-to-black gradient, scattered stars, a faint pink aurora haze on the horizon and a distant neon city skyline silhouette with glowing pink and cyan window strips.

sfx.prompt: Bright rising arpeggio blip with a glassy synth chime, like banking a charged core
Electric whoosh with a fast rising pitch, synth dash burst
Gritty distorted thud with a short metallic ring, punchy hit
Power-down sweep: descending synth glide with crackling static tail
Triumphant synthwave riser landing on a bright chord stab
Low detuned drone with a sad synthwave hit, fading to static

props.name: neon_pillar
props.prompt: One tall hexagonal colosseum pillar, dark charcoal stone with two emissive neon bands — one hot pink, one cyan — and a glowing ring at the top

props.name: holo_obelisk
props.prompt: One slim obelisk monolith, black glass with a faceted cyan crystal tip and a thin magenta seam of light running up its face

features: Thruster trail: constant cyan FX.trail behind the hover-robot that flares on dash bursts.
Hit juice: FX.hitFlash + FX.burst + FX.shake on every enemy contact, with a red edge flash.
Core pickup juice: FX.ring shockwave + FX.sparkle + floating '+1' FX.text on every energy core.
Slow-mo finale: FX.slowmo the moment the last needed core is banked.
Two spinner hazards sweeping the arena midline for extra risk (Gameplay hazards).
Scifi HUD with core counter, timer and lives; UI.banner on each wave spawn and a big-text warning when the clock drops below 30s.
plan.mapping_notes: The pitch's "twin-stick arena shooter" has no shooting system in the kits, so the fantasy is kept as topdown dash-and-dodge: the hover-robot (topdown player, cyan body / pink accent) sprints through waves of 'chase' enemies (the spiky orbs) and 'patrol' enemies (the slimes) in a medium arena — 10 enemies total, 6 chase + 4 patrol. Mouse aim keeps the twin-stick feel (the bot faces the cursor) and the "blasting" energy is carried by dash bursts, hit flash, spark bursts and screen shake. "Energy cores" map to the 'orb' collectible (40 placed, 25 to win). The pitch's "survive the timer" is inverted to the kit's time-limit model: the 150s clock is a survival timer and the win is banking the core target before it dies — the timer stays the pressure. "Synthwave colosseum at night" → neon_night look + arena level + generated midnight sky with a neon skyline; neon pillars and holo obelisks dress the colosseum. Scifi HUD → UI scifi style with generated gem/clock/heart/skull icons. No race (laps 0, opponents 0) and no goal portal (goal false) — the arena itself is the stage.

result.summary: Neon Arena is built and runs with zero console errors. The scaffold was tuned into the plan's game: neon_night look with cyan/pink palette and boosted bloom; the kit's arena exterior foliage and clouds are hidden (they broke the "colosseum at night" mood) so the scene reads as a clean glowing colosseum; the plan's two spinner hazards sweep the arena midline; the scifi HUD uses the generated gem/clock/heart icons with a core counter (target 25), timer, lives and minimap; win/lose screens are themed (GRID CLEARED / SIGNAL LOST); the title screen sells the fantasy with the tagline and control credit. Juice: cyan→pink thruster trail on the hover-robot, core pickup ring + sparkle + floating '+1', hit juice (hitFlash + spark burst + shake + red edge flash), death burst, slow-mo + confetti on win, red flash on lose, and big-text banners at start and when the clock drops below 30s/10s. Autopilot playtest: player moves along the route and collects (13/25 cores in ~10s), no errors, 150fps.
changes: Look.apply with palette (cyan #00e5ff / pink #ff2d95) and stronger bloom for the neon_night look
Hid kit arena exterior foliage (kit:foliage:* instanced meshes) and clouds so the arena reads as a night colosseum
Added two spinner hazards crossing the arena midline for extra risk
Scifi HUD with generated gem/clock/heart icons, core counter with target 25, timer, lives, minimap, themed win/lose screens
Title screen with tagline subtitle and control credit line
FX.trail cyan→pink thruster trail behind the player
Event juice: collect (ring+sparkle+floating +1), damage (hitFlash+burst+shake+red vignette flash), death (big burst+shake), win (slowmo+confetti+ring), lose (red flash)
Per-frame timer warnings: banners at 30s and 10s remaining, shake at 10s
known_issues: Mouse aim is not true twin-stick cursor-facing: the kit's topdown controller only reads mouse deltas when pointer-locked (documented 'lookX/lookY' input), so the bot faces movement direction rather than the cursor; the plan's twin-stick feel is approximated by the dash + aim-free topdown movement
The arena's bounce pads and fountain (kit defaults) remain in play; they add movement variety but were not in the plan
Exterior foliage was hidden by object name matching (kit:foliage:*), which depends on the kit's internal naming; if the kit renames foliage the filter would need updating
Autopilot dies once during the 10s test (enemy contact) but recovers and keeps collecting — expected given 8+ chasing enemies
